title: web: index.html, style.css, api.js, clock.js, ws.js, format.js
criteria:
Build the static frontend foundation (vanilla JS ES modules, no framework, no build step, no Node deps). All user-visible text in Thai. web/js/api.js: `export class ApiError extends Error` with fields `code`, `message`, `status`; `export const api = { get(path), post(path, body), patch(path, body) }` where `path` is relative to /api (e.g. api.get('/state') fetches '/api/state'); sends/receives JSON; on a non-2xx response parses {error:{code,message}} and throws ApiError (when the body is not that shape use code 'HTTP_ERROR' and message 'เกิดข้อผิดพลาด ()'); network failure -> ApiError code 'NETWORK' message 'เชื่อมต่อเซิร์ฟเวอร์ไม่ได้'. web/js/clock.js: keeps `offsetMs` = Date.parse(game_now) - Date.now() set by `export function syncClock(gameNowIso)`; `export function gameNow()` returns a Date = Date.now() + offsetMs; `export function countdown(iso)` returns the remaining time until the ISO timestamp (game time) as 'H:MM:SS' (hours not zero-padded, minimum '0:00:00'); `export function remainingMs(iso)`. web/js/ws.js: `export function onChanged(cb)` registers a callback (returns an unsubscribe function) called with the parsed message for every {type:'changed', kind, village_id}; the module connects lazily on the first onChanged call to `ws(s):///ws`, reconnects automatically with backoff delays 1, 2, 5, 10, 10, ... seconds (reset after a successful open), sends the text 'ping' every 25 seconds while open, and ignores 'pong' and unparsable messages. web/js/format.js: `fmtNum(n)` floors to an integer and groups thousands with commas (negative numbers keep the minus sign); `fmtDuration(seconds)` -> 'H:MM:SS' (same style as countdown, whole seconds, rounded up); `fmtTime(iso)` -> local date-time string using toLocaleString('th-TH') or '' for falsy input. web/index.html: valid HTML5, lang='th', viewport meta (width=device-width, initial-scale=1), title 'Realm of Villages', link css/style.css, and this skeleton: `

- No external libraries/CDNs. Plain DOM APIs only.
- Escape nothing special here, but never use innerHTML with server text anywhere (later tasks rely on api.js only returning data).
- Run the test_cmd (node --check on every js file) and fix syntax errors.
